subject: Every site is a landing page for Aether (placeholder brand): AI models, low-refusal and abliterated variants, unified chat, coding agents and a developer API sold per token. The 20 blueprints supply visual language only.
uniqueness_law: No two sites share a heading font, accent colour, hero layout structure or signature scroll mechanic. Checked by _build/registry.plan.mjs on every build.

sites.signature_scroll_mechanic: Scroll-exploded calibre: a pinned canvas lifts five movement layers apart with engineering callouts
sites.hero_layout_type: Asymmetric 5/7 split: type column left, live calibre canvas right

sites.signature_scroll_mechanic: Blueprint-to-structure scrubber: linework draws itself, then solidifies into shaded pavilions with a sun-angle shadow slider
sites.hero_layout_type: Slab stack: full-width headline slab over a blueprint band, CTA cast into a concrete block

sites.signature_scroll_mechanic: Orbital shell lock-on: scroll moves the camera through LEO, MEO and GEO shells while a sticky rail prints avoidance receipts
sites.hero_layout_type: HUD corners: full-bleed 3D globe, headline top-left, live readouts pinned to the corners

sites.inspiration: Computational protein and mycelium materials lab
sites.signature_scroll_mechanic: Scroll-grown mycelium: a branching network grows down the page through nine lab receipts
sites.hero_layout_type: Specimen plate: centred framed plate with mycelium growing past its borders

sites.blueprint_heading_font: Clash Display (Fontshare is unreachable from the build machine, so it cannot be self-hosted; Funnel Display is the closest open grotesk display)
sites.signature_scroll_mechanic: Playable frequency synthesiser: Web Audio tone with bass/mid/treble isolation; scroll drives the waveform phase and sweep
sites.hero_layout_type: Horizon line: headline above a full-width live waveform that splits the viewport, CTA below the line

sites.signature_scroll_mechanic: Pinned horizontal scent pyramid: top, heart and base notes evaporate as particle diffusion
sites.hero_layout_type: Triptych: copy column, particle flacon in the centre column, note ledger on the right

sites.blueprint_heading_font: Cabinet Grotesk (Fontshare-only, unreachable from the build machine; Host Grotesk shares its quirky grotesk construction)
sites.signature_scroll_mechanic: Scroll-ramped confinement torus: plasma heats from 1M to 150M °C, firing net-gain milestones
sites.hero_layout_type: Report cover: oversized live temperature readout as the visual with the torus overlaid, headline set bottom-left

sites.signature_scroll_mechanic: Elevation altimeter: a sticky gauge descends 1,200 m to 400 m with soil strata, rainfall and tasting notes per band
sites.hero_layout_type: Centred wine label: symmetric crest, headline and terroir line over contour lines

sites.signature_scroll_mechanic: Scroll-bent kinematic leg rig with live joint-torque and metabolic-load readouts
sites.hero_layout_type: Telemetry panel: full-bleed kinematic rig with copy locked into a framed bottom-left panel

sites.signature_scroll_mechanic: Cipher decode on entry: headings decrypt and a Merkle proof tree verifies leaf by leaf as sections arrive
sites.hero_layout_type: Exposed grid cells: headline spanning cells above a proof-tree cell block

sites.signature_scroll_mechanic: Depth-gauge descent from +4,000 m to −10,928 m with live pressure readouts and sonar pings
sites.hero_layout_type: Depth column: vertical gauge strip on the left edge, copy right, sonar field behind

sites.inspiration: Precision CNC aluminium kitchen and living systems
sites.signature_scroll_mechanic: Snap-together configurator: modules spring into a rail as you scroll, plus a before/after room scrubber
sites.hero_layout_type: Tool-first: copy top-left, a live modular configurator occupying the lower-right grid

sites.inspiration: Non-invasive neural interface for creative workstations
sites.blueprint_heading_font: Satoshi (Fontshare-only, unreachable from the build machine; Urbanist keeps its geometric modernist skeleton)
sites.signature_scroll_mechanic: Focus-seeking constellation: synaptic pulses fire toward whichever card or CTA is focused or scrolled to
sites.hero_layout_type: Off-centre float: copy in the lower-right third, neural constellation filling the rest

sites.signature_scroll_mechanic: Scroll-driven CFD streamlines flowing over the frame, with a live CdA comparison slider
sites.hero_layout_type: Streamline band: stacked headline over a full-bleed CFD band, drag readout docked right

sites.signature_scroll_mechanic: Scroll-paced stone mill: the granite mill turns with scroll and unlocks farmer provenance certificates
sites.hero_layout_type: Shoji panels: three paper panels that slide apart, copy in the centre panel, vertical tategaki label

sites.blueprint_heading_font: Syne (already the heading font of 02; the uniqueness law forbids a repeat)
sites.signature_scroll_mechanic: Scroll-pinned flight strips advance along the flight path, plus a wingspan solar-flux calculator
sites.hero_layout_type: Sky over instrument band: sky canvas fills the upper field, copy and CTA sit in a band of flight-strip readouts

sites.blueprint_heading_font: Fraunces (already the heading font of 04; the uniqueness law forbids a repeat)
sites.signature_scroll_mechanic: Scroll-plotted roast profile: scroll advances roast time through drying, Maillard, first crack and development
sites.hero_layout_type: Chart-as-hero: the live roast curve plotted across the hero, headline set inside the chart area

sites.inspiration: Optical silicon interconnects for AI datacentres
sites.blueprint_heading_font: Clash Display (already planned for 05 and Fontshare-only; the uniqueness law forbids a repeat)
sites.signature_scroll_mechanic: Photonic packet routing: scroll fires laser packets through logic gates while copper and optical loss are compared live
sites.hero_layout_type: Die floorplan: the hero is laid out as chip blocks joined by glowing waveguides

sites.inspiration: Rare book conservation and manuscript vault
sites.blueprint_heading_font: Cormorant Garamond (already the heading font of 01; the uniqueness law forbids a repeat)
sites.signature_scroll_mechanic: Spectral inspection loupe: a cursor- and scroll-steered loupe reveals UV, infrared and X-ray layers
sites.hero_layout_type: Open-book spread: copy on the left page, manuscript with a live loupe on the right page

sites.blueprint_heading_font: Unbounded (already the heading font of 03; the uniqueness law forbids a repeat)
sites.signature_scroll_mechanic: Split-flap route board flips city pairs on scroll while a Mach cone sweeps across a route globe
